severity.description: HIGH blocks the merge until fixed or disposed; MEDIUM and LOW do not.

security.description: true when the finding is a security defect; a security finding blocks the merge whatever its severity.

rule.description: The ONE id this finding violates: a principle id or a registry rule id from the list above; an unknown id refuses the finding.

file.description: The repo-relative path, no line number.

anchor.description: One line of the file the finding is about, copied VERBATIM (never a line number): with rule and file it is the finding's identity across review rounds.
